headline: ICAO and the Challenges of Aviation
summary: The ICAO's Seventh World Air Transport Conference was held in Montreal from November 16 to 20. The agenda covered market liberalisation, investment, new technologies and strengthened oversight.
why: ICAO is the International Civil Aviation Organization, a UN agency that sets global aviation standards. Its rules shape airline competition, investment flows and airport operations.
original_headline: OACI y los retos de la aviación
